title: Senior Analyst - Digital Marketing
description:
**Company Description**  

Metro Global Solution Center (MGSC) is internal solution partner for METRO, a €31\.6 Billion international wholesaler with operations in more than 30 countries. The store network comprises a total of 623 stores in 21 countries, of which 522 offer out\-of\-store delivery (OOS), and 94 dedicated depots. In 12 countries, METRO runs only the delivery business by its delivery companies (Food Service Distribution, FSD).  

  

HoReCa and Traders are core customer groups of METRO. The HoReCa section includes hotels, restaurants, catering companies as well as bars, cafés and canteen operators. The Traders section includes small grocery stores and kiosks. The majority of all customer groups are small and medium\-sized enterprises as well as sole traders. METRO helps them manage their business challenges more effectively.  

  

MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide HR, Finance, IT \& Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24\+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers.  



Website: https://www.metro\-gsc.in  

Company Size: 1000\-1100  

Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India  

Type: Privately Held  

Inception: 2011

 **Job Description** **Role Overview**


As part of METRO's Global Solution Center, India, you provide operational, analytical and coordination support across METRO's digital marketing activities, working closely with local market marketing teams, category management, e\-commerce, CRM and content stakeholders. This role supports end\-to\-end digital marketing execution by enabling campaign delivery, content and asset management, channel operations, reporting and performance monitoring across web, app, email and digital channels. Operating within established marketing processes, governance frameworks and service delivery standards, the Digital Marketing Expert contributes to continuous improvement, data quality and consistent execution, working closely with Marketing Team to support digital marketing performance across METRO countries.

**Key Responsibilities**


Operational:

* Execute digital marketing campaigns across web, app, email and digital catalog channels for weekly offers, seasonal activities and general campaigns
* Upload graphical content, assets and campaign materials into content management and marketing platforms
* Configure digital content parameters – duration, placement, target groups and store assignments – in line with campaign briefings.
* Set up, test and launch push notifications, newsletters and other customer communications.
* Maintain website content and landing pages, including publishing, unpublishing, redirects and structured data updates
* Build and configure digital and dynamic catalogs, including layout, product hotspots, metadata and audience settings.
* Manage content input from Category Management, Sales, Own Brand, Marketing and external agencies to secure complete and accurate campaign content
* Support in delivering email marketing from newsletter creation, content integration, A/B testing


Continuous improvement:

* Identify opportunities to streamline digital marketing execution
* Standardize templates, content structures and operational procedures
* Safeguard data quality, tagging and taxonomy across digital marketing platform


Collaboration:

* Partner with local marketing teams, Category Management, Customer Insights and CRM to enable campaign execution
* Work closely with external agencies and freelancers on timely delivery of digital marketing content
* Facilitate alignment on campaign inputs, timelines and content requirements

 **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Marketing, Communication or a related field preferred
* Minimum 4\-7 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations or a related support function
* Experience in retail/wholesale or consumer goods / FMCG is a plus

**Primary Skills (Required)**

* Solid understanding of digital marketing processes across web, app, email and content operations.
* Hands\-on experience with content management, email marketing (experience with Adobe Marketing Automation is a plus) and digital catalog platforms
* Analytical skills to monitor and analyze performance using web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker Studio)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with CMS and digital marketing tools is a plus
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively in a remote, collaborative team environment
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Fluency in professional English
* Cultural awareness and respect in a multinational, cross\-functional setting

**Secondary Skills (Preferred)**

* Familiarity with tagging, tracking and web analytics concepts (e.g., UTM parameters, campaign tracking)
* Fluency in additional languages is a plus
* Strong aptitude for identifying process improvement opportunities
* Skilled in coordinating cross\-functional inputs and managing stakeholder expectations
* Strong social competence to connect, build networks and support collaboration

 **Additional Information**  

* Participation in international projects across 21 countries
* Exciting work in the dynamic environment of METRO, one of the leading global wholesale companies
* Real opportunities for creative input and implementing your own ideas and solutions
* Career development opportunities in various areas of modern retail operations
* Friendly and informal working atmosphere

title: Apps Development Group Manager - C14 - PUNE
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Applications Development Group Manager is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to establish and implement new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. The overall objective of this role is to drive applications systems analysis and programming activities.


**Responsibilities:**


* Responsible for client engagement and management, end to end management and delivery of the technology Book Of Work and technology roadmap for the Data and Reporting.
* Deliver EIM and Issue Management Data, including CAPs, Exceptions, Milestones, and the end\-to\-end issue management lifecycle and workflows.
* Influence and negotiate with senior business and technology stakeholders across lines of businesses within Controls Technology
* Provide strategic direction and coordinate with other modules leads for data and reporting integrations and enhancements.
* Lead the implementation of data strategy roadmap for the enterprise data, including data management for our enterprise data, warehouse and advanced data analytics/reporting solutions
* Design, build and maintain batch or real\-time data pipelines in data platform.
* Maintain and optimize the data infrastructure required for accurate extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources.
* Develop ETL (extract, transform, load) processes to help extract and manipulate data from multiple sources.
* Automate data workflows such as data ingestion, aggregation, and ETL processing.
* Prepare raw data in Data Warehouses into a consumable dataset for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Partner with data scientists and functional leaders in sales, marketing, and product to deploy machine learning models in production.
* Build, maintain, and deploy data products for analytics and data science teams on data platform
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, privacy, security, and compliance through quality control procedures.
* Monitor data systems performance and implement optimization strategies.
* Leverage data controls to maintain data privacy, security, compliance, and quality for allocated areas of ownership.
* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
* Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in\-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
* Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
* Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
* Provide in\-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Serve as advisor or coach to mid\-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

  

**Qualifications:**


* 15 to 20 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, Reporting, and Enterprise Data Transformation initiatives within large\-scale financial services organizations.
* Strong knowledge of the EIM and Issue Management domain, including CAPs, Exceptions, Milestones, and the end\-to\-end issue management lifecycle and workflows.
* Proven leadership in delivering enterprise\-wide data transformation and modernization programs, including new data application design, ETL and platform migrations, historical data migration automation, large\-scale consumer onboarding, and platform performance optimization.
* Strong expertise in leading large\-scale Data Engineering organizations and delivering enterprise data platforms, with deep experience in Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL processing, data ingestion, reporting, enterprise data distribution, Data Quality, Data Governance, Security, Entitlements, and Internal Audit frameworks.
* Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases and database design.
* Demonstrated expertise in defining target\-state architecture, transformation strategy, technology roadmaps, and delivery governance for complex data modernization programs.
* Proven ability to lead operational support, platform stability, service management, and large\-scale transformation initiatives simultaneously while maintaining delivery excellence.
* Extensive experience in stakeholder management, executive communications, governance, and influencing senior business and technology leaders, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with performance tuning and load window optimization.
* Excellent leadership, program management, problem\-solving, communication, and people management skills, with a proven track record of building trusted relationships across business and technology organizations.
* Ability to adjust priorities quickly and work effectively both independently and within cross\-functional global teams.

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree/University degree In Information Technology / Computer science
* Master’s degree preferred

title: AI SEO Engineer
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**  

  

Seniority level: Associate level

Experience: 2\+ yrs



Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India



Job Type: Full\-time



We are looking for an experienced and forward\-thinking **AI SEO Engineer – Search Everywhere Builder** to drive the next generation of enterprise SEO through a combination of **SEO expertise, engineering, AI, automation, and agentic technologies**.



The ideal candidate will be an SEO\-first professional who thinks like an engineer and can transform search requirements into scalable, automated, and production\-ready digital experiences. You will focus on improving discoverability and organic growth across traditional search, AI\-powered search, social platforms, marketplaces, video platforms, and other emerging search ecosystems.



**Requirements**
----------------


### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Lead enterprise SEO strategy across **content, keyword ecosystems, information architecture, search intent, topical authority, and organic growth**.
* Develop and execute **Search Everywhere** strategies across Google Search, AI search engines, LLMs, social search, marketplaces, video platforms, and internal search experiences.
* Partner with Technical SEO, Product, Engineering, Content, Analytics, and UX teams to embed SEO throughout the product and content lifecycle.
* Develop SEO and **GEO best practices, governance frameworks, and AI\-first operating models** for scalable execution.
* Build and deploy **AI agents, automation workflows, and pipelines** to improve SEO productivity and reduce repetitive manual execution.
* Leverage AI and automation to accelerate content production while maintaining quality, relevance, and governance standards.
* Develop scalable strategies across multiple business verticals, website templates, content types, and customer journeys.
* Strengthen internal linking, entity SEO, topical authority, programmatic SEO, and search intent optimisation.
* Continuously research emerging changes in search engines, LLMs, AI search, and generative search experiences.
* Prototype, test, measure, and productionise innovative SEO solutions and workflows.
* Use data and search performance insights to identify opportunities for improved visibility, traffic, engagement, and business outcomes.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to translate SEO requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Establish repeatable systems and processes that enable SEO execution at enterprise scale.

### **WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT**


* **3–5 years of hands\-on Enterprise SEO experience**, ideally managing large\-scale websites and demonstrating measurable impact on organic growth and business outcomes.
* Strong expertise in **SEO, keyword strategy, information architecture, search intent mapping, topical authority, and internal linking**.
* Strong understanding of **Entity SEO, Programmatic SEO, and Search Everywhere optimisation**.
* Experience developing and scaling SEO strategies across multiple business verticals, templates, content ecosystems, and customer journeys.
* Deep understanding of **Google Search, AI Search, LLMs, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise SEO platforms such as **SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Moz**.
* Experience using **AI/LLM platforms, agentic frameworks, and automation tools** to improve SEO workflows.
* Comfortable working with programming or engineering technologies to build and scale SEO solutions.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO principles and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret search data, identify opportunities, and measure SEO impact.
* Strong experimentation mindset with the ability to rapidly prototype, test, learn, and productionise new solutions.
* Ability to balance SEO quality, scalability, automation, and governance.
* Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* A strong interest in **AI\-native SEO, automation, agentic systems, and the evolving search ecosystem**.

Job Description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**


* Responsible for all activities and processes related to the creation, maintenance, governance, and continuous improvement of Product Data Management.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ideate, create, and enforce business rules to manage product data, material masters, bill of materials, and change management processes.
* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives utilizing tools such as Winshuttle, Excel VBA, SAP, Windchill, and other relevant technologies to improve efficiency, accuracy, and data integrity.
* Extract, analyze, and interpret large volumes of data from SAP, Windchill, and other enterprise systems to support business decisions, audits, and process improvements.
* Create process documentation, provide technical guidance and training to peers and team members, and lead projects related to Product Data Management and Engineering Systems.
* Provide daily operational support to business units through SAP material master lifecycle maintenance while balancing strategic improvement initiatives and project responsibilities.

**1\. Data Engineering, Reporting \& Analytics**


**Expected End Results** Extract, analyze, interpret, and present large amounts of data to support business decisions, audits, and process improvements.

  

**Major Activities**


* Continuous support of PDM teams and customers to extract and analyze data from SAP tables, databases, Windchill, and other enterprise systems.
  

* Support cross\-functional groups with ad hoc data requests, reporting, and root cause analysis.
* Develop complex data extracts, dashboards, audit reports, and analytics to drive informed business decisions.
* Provide technical support, guidance, and training to requestors and team members.

**2\. Develop Automation Tools**


**Expected End Results** Develop workflows, automation tools, and technical solutions to improve efficiency, standardization, and data quality.


**Major Activities**


* Develop, maintain, and enhance Winshuttle scripts, Excel VBA tools, templates, and automation solutions.
* Partner with PDM teams and stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and eliminate manual work.
* Design, build, test, deploy, and support automation tools and process improvements.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and best practices to improve productivity and team effectiveness.
* Provide technical mentorship and support to team members utilizing automation tools.

**3\. Audits**


**Expected End Results** Analyse, develop, and enhance audits as a tool for data quality and governance.


**Major Activities**


* Understand complex business rules and develop audit extracts to influence and improve data integrity.
* Perform advanced data analysis to identify root causes and corrective actions.
* Leverage SAP tables, databases, and enterprise systems to execute large\-scale audits and support decision\-making.
* Recommend process improvements based on audit findings and trends.

**4\. Data Storage \& Handling**


**Expected End Results** Ensure secure, accurate, and efficient storage and management of data, reports, and technical documentation.

  

**Major Activities**


* Storage and maintenance of documents, reports, automation tools, and business data on global servers.
* Develop and maintain new processes, standards, and best practices for data management.
* Ensure timely backup and recovery of stored data.
* Create, manage, and optimize databases and repositories to support business needs.
* Maintain technical documentation and knowledge management resources.

**5\. Project Management**


**Expected End Results** Lead projects and continuous improvement initiatives while effectively managing operational responsibilities.


**Major Activities**


* Represent Product Data Management by leading and supporting local, regional, and global projects.
* Drive automation, standardization, and process improvement initiatives.
* Make informed technical and operational decisions on behalf of the Product Data Management team.
* Effectively document, communicate, and present project outcomes and recommendations.
* Balance project execution with day\-to\-day operational workload and stakeholder commitments.
* Mentor peers and support knowledge transfer activities across the team.
  

**Relevant Experience**


**Engineer:** 4\-7 years


**Senior Engineer (recommended):**


* **4\-7 years of relevant experience in Product Data Management, SAP, PLM/PDM systems, Engineering Systems, Data Analytics, or Process Automation.**

**Personal Characteristics \& Technical Expertise**


* Strong written and verbal communication skills with effective presentation and stakeholder management abilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SAP, Windchill, and other Product Data Management (PDM) or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications.
* Strong customer focus and excellent customer service skills.
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with experience working with large datasets.
* Hands\-on experience developing automation tools using **Excel VBA, macros, Winshuttle, SAP data extraction tools, and related technologies.**
* Ability to extract, analyse, and interpret large volumes of data from SAP databases and enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of Material Master, BOM, Engineering Change Management, and Product Lifecycle processes.
* Creative thinker with a continuous improvement mindset and a passion for automation and digital transformation.
* Ability to balance technical development, project work, and day\-to\-day operational support.
* Experience mentoring peers and providing technical guidance to team members.
* Flexibility to support a wide variety of work related to Product Data \& Lifecycle Management.

  

**Preferred Skills**


* Winshuttle Studio
* Advanced Excel VBA / Macro Development
* SAP Data Extraction and Reporting
* Windchill PLM Administration/User Experience
* Data Analysis and Visualization
* SQL (Optional)
* Power BI (Optional)
  

**RELATIONSHIPS AND CONTACTS:**


Supervisory relationships: \- Reports to: Manager – Engineering Systems \& PDM

  

**Organization relationships:** \- Regular contact with Kohler Global PDM Teams, IT, Project Management and Engineering community. \- Frequent contact with Marketing, SCM \& Service Teams. \- Regular contact with peers, superiors, and junior associates. \- Occasional interactions with other business units and departments such as QA, Plant, Process Engg, Product Engg, Purchasing, Warehouse teams, Supply Chain, Customer Service.

  

**External business relationships:** \- Participating in technical forums/webinars to explore the techniques and programs related to PDM systems, processes, and tools. \- Third party service providers, partners, and suppliers/ vendors.


Mandatory Skills:
SAP MM , Data Analysis, Data Management, BOM, Windchill, Winshuttle, VBA, Data Quality

Job Description:

Beyond the competitive benefits and compensation, Kohler proudly offers a rich culture, steeped in creativity and commitment to our associates and communities. We invite you to learn more about our culture and company at www.kohlercompany.com


It is Kohler’s policy to recruit, hire, and promote qualified personnel in all job classifications without regard to race, creed, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Kohler Co. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.


**Kohler India is certified as a Great Place to Work Organization. This certification is an endorsement of the culture and values we live by \- every day.**

  

**Position Description**


**Position Title**

  

AM – Customer Care

  

  

**Department**

  

Customer Services

  

  

**Division**

  

Kohler India Technical Center, Pune

  

  

**Grade**

  

AM

  

  

**Reporting to**

Manager – Customer Care

  

  

**About the position:**

We (Kohler India Technical Center) are a captive global center providing technical and nontechnical support for all the businesses and product lines for Kohler India (Kitchen and Bath).


As a Customer Care Assistant Manager at Kohler, you will be responsible for managing the daily operations of our Customer Care department. You will oversee a team of customer care associates, ensuring that they provide excellent service to our end consumers. In this role, you will be responsible for setting goals and metrics, monitoring performance, and implementing strategies to improve customer experience. You will also work closely with other departments to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.


**Role and Responsibility:**


**Be a Brand Ambassador for our customers by building relationships and creating loyalty**. Provide world\-class first level inbound phone/chat/email support for customers by troubleshooting, investigating, and resolving customers' inquiries about Kohler India products with the goal of resolving each issue on the first contact. You will be expected to provide empathetic, courteous, quality customer service in an accurate and timely manner in accordance with Kohler protocols while maintaining a positive, problem\-solving approach.

  

* Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Customer Care department.
* Hire, train, and supervise a team of customer service associates.
* Set performance goals and metrics for the team and monitor progress.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve customer experience.
* Maintain and improve customer service level agreements and procedures.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and provide regular reports to senior management.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key customers.
* Provide coaching and feedback to team members to improve their performance and development.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, as well as applicable regulations and laws.

**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree mandatory – master’s degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in customer service or related field, with at least 5 years in a people management role.
* Strong leadership, Problem solving and People management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop strategies.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and customer service software.
* Experience working in the manufacturing industry is preferred.
  

This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.


**Working Conditions:**


This is a full\-time role based in our customer service Pune office. The includes evenings and weekends working to meet customer demands, as we operate 24/7\. You'll work six days a week with rotating shifts and weekly offs. Occasional travel for business may also be required.


**Organizational Relationships:**

* Reports to Manager – Customer Care,
* Regular interactions with business stakeholders from different Kohler business verticals at ITC
* Frequent interaction with internal stakeholders including senior leadership team.

Team Management, Escalation Management, People Leadership, Inbound Voice Process, Data Analytics, Reports and Dashboards

title: Marketing Executive
description:
**Marketing Executive**
=======================

#### **Full Time**


#### **PUNE**

  

Job Summary  

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic, and target\-driven Marketing Executive to promote our overseas education services and strengthen our presence across schools, colleges, coaching centres, and other educational institutions. This is a field\-intensive role, with approximately 70% of the time spent travelling to educational institutions, conducting promotional activities, organising seminars, and building relationships with key stakeholders.  

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and networking skills, be comfortable with extensive travel, and have a passion for interacting with students and educational professionals. **Key Responsibilities**  

* Institutional Outreach \& Relationship Management
* Visit schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and educational organisations to promote the company's overseas education services.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with principals, counsellors, placement officers, teachers, and institutional decision\-makers.
* Identify and develop new institutional partnerships to expand the company's network.

  

* Marketing \& Student Engagement

* Organise and coordinate seminars, career guidance sessions, education fairs, workshops, and promotional events.
* Deliver presentations on overseas education opportunities, study destinations, universities, admission processes, scholarships, and visa pathways.
* Represent the company at educational events and exhibitions.
* Distribute marketing materials and ensure effective brand visibility at partner institutions.

  

* Lead Generation

* Generate quality student leads through institutional visits and promotional activities.
* Collect and maintain accurate student data and enquiry information.
* Ensure timely follow\-up of leads by coordinating with the counselling and admissions teams.
* Meet monthly lead generation and institutional visit targets.

  

* Business Development

* Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and student engagement.
* Develop new marketing initiatives to expand the company's reach.
* Gather market intelligence, competitor information, and student preferences.

  

* Reporting \& Administration

* Maintain records of daily field visits, institutional meetings, seminars conducted, and leads generated.
* Submit regular activity reports and market feedback to the reporting manager.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of marketing campaigns and events.

  

* Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Education, Communications, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in field marketing, educational marketing, business development, admissions, or sales.
* Experience in the overseas education industry is preferred but not mandatory.

  

* Required Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong networking and relationship\-building abilities.
* Confidence in speaking to large student groups and institutional representatives.
* Strong organisational and event coordination skills.
* Lead generation and business development skills.
* Good negotiation and persuasion abilities.
* Basic knowledge of overseas education, study abroad programmes, or international admissions is an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM software is preferred.

  

* Key Competencies

* Self\-motivated and target\-oriented.
* Professional and confident personality.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong problem\-solving and planning skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively.

  

* Working Conditions

  

\* Approximately \*\*70% field work\*\* involving regular travel to schools, colleges, coaching centres, and educational institutions.* 30% office\-based work for planning, reporting, coordination, and follow\-up.
* Local travel on a daily basis, with occasional outstation travel for education fairs, seminars, and institutional partnerships.
* Flexible working hours during events and admission seasons.

  

* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of institutional visits completed.
* Number of new institutional partnerships established.
* Number of seminars, workshops, and promotional events organised.
* Student enquiries and qualified leads generated.
* Conversion of leads into counselling appointments and admissions.
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly marketing targets.
* Quality of institutional relationships and repeat engagement.
* Timely submission of activity reports and market feedback.

  

* Preferred Candidate Profile

* Passionate about education and student engagement.
* Comfortable travelling extensively and working in the field.
* Energetic, proactive, and results\-driven.
* Possesses a valid driving licence and own vehicle (preferred).
* Fluent in English and the local language.

  

Interested candidates can mail updated resume to vacancies@edwiseinternational.com or can call on **022 4081 3****488**
